name: WeKnora Read-only Bridge
description: Optional read-only bridge to a WeKnora HTTP/MCP endpoint. Disabled by default. Prefer the CLI weknora_search tool (WEKNORA_BASE_URL) for remote search; local SQLite remains the default KB.

config.notes: Leave disabled until a real WeKnora MCP endpoint is available. For HTTP search without MCP, use plugins_volume/cli/weknora_search.py with WEKNORA_BASE_URL (+ optional WEKNORA_API_KEY, WEKNORA_SEARCH_PATH, WEKNORA_KB_ID). NLM does not clone WeKnora Wiki/GraphRAG.
